summary.plain: NuTeV measured the weak mixing angle from the ratio of neutral-current to charged-current neutrino interactions. Its value was three standard deviations above the Standard Model prediction, the so-called NuTeV anomaly; later work found that part of the gap could come from nuclear and QCD effects.
summary.technical: Extraction of sin^2(theta_W) from NC/CC cross-section ratios for neutrinos and antineutrinos: sin^2(theta_W)(on-shell) = 0.2277 +- 0.0013 (stat) +- 0.0009 (syst), 3 sigma above the Standard Model; also a model-independent analysis of the same data.

title: A Precise Determination of Electroweak Parameters in Neutrino-Nucleon Scattering
why_it_matters: The most notable tension between a low-energy weak-mixing-angle measurement and the Standard Model; it motivated decades of work on neutrino-nucleus cross sections and parton-level effects.
